PS3:nba-live-08.d: NBA Live 08 is the 2007 installment of the NBA Live series by EA Sports. It was released for the PlayStation 2, Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Wii, Windows and PlayStation Portable. This is the first NBA video game to include all three next-generation consoles, the first game to be released for Sony's PlayStation 3, and the last NBA Live game for the Windows platform.

PS3:tower-of-guns.d: Tower of Guns is a roguelike single-player first-person shooter video game developed by Terrible Posture Games and published by Grip Digital. The game was released on March 4, 2014, to generally positive reviews, and later released on PS4 and Xbox One in April 2015.

Switch:five-nights-at-freddys-4.d: Five Nights at Freddy's 4 (FNaF 4) is a 2015 point-and-click survival horror game developed by Scott Cawthon. The game is set in a child's bedroom, where the player must avoid attacks from nightmarish animatronics stalking them. In contrast to previous games in the Five Nights at Freddy's series, there is no series of security cameras to monitor animatronic progression, and instead the player must rely on audio cues to find them and use their flashlight to fend them off. In between nights, the player can play Atari-styled minigames which tell the story of a young boy who is consistently tormented by his older brother.

A Nintendo DS version, titled Zoo Tycoon 2 DS, was released in 2008. Similar to its predecessor, 2001's Zoo Tycoon, the objective is to build and operate a zoo by creating exhibits and aquariums, keeping guests and animals happy, and maintaining employees, finances, terrain, foliage, and scenery.

CV:looping.d: Looping is an action game developed and published in arcades in 1982 by Video Games GmbH in Europe and Venture Line in North America. The player controls a plane across two phases in order to reach a docking station by destroying a terminal base or a rocket base to open a gate while avoiding obstacles along the way. Conceived by Italian designer and engineer Giorgio Ugozzoli, Looping was the second of two original games produced by German game developer Video Games GmbH, the first being Super Tank (1981). The idea came up during a period when Ugozzoli obtained a license for both gliding and engine aircraft due to being a fan of flying.
